purpose: keep accurate, findable answers to recurring questions so users and support solve problems without escalation
entry_criteria: Recurring questions and incidents are identified from tickets
A knowledge base tool and owners exist
procedure: Pick the questions that recur most from tickets and search queries.
Write each article for a named audience: problem as the user states it, steps, expected result, and when to escalate.
Have a subject-matter expert check accuracy and test the steps on a current build.
Tag and title articles with the words users actually search for; link related articles.
Review articles when the product changes and retire outdated ones.
Measure whether articles reduce tickets and fix those that do not.
acceptance_criteria: Steps were tested on the current build
Each article has an owner and review date
Searches for top questions find an article
validation_method: Subject-matter expert review of each new article.

validation.check: follow each new article's steps on a current build
search the knowledge base for the top five ticket topics
validation.expect: each returns the right article first

failure_modes.detection: Search for the user's wording returns nothing

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The most common ticket is password reset failing for SSO users. An article explains that SSO users reset in their identity provider, with steps and a link, and ticket volume for that topic falls the next month.
